question: Should AgentHarness skip malformed/unreadable tool descriptors to preserve healthy sibling tools, or fail registration with AgentHarnessError when any supplied tool has an invalid name?
rationale: Both open drafts are technically plausible and touch the same compatibility-sensitive registry boundary, but they encode incompatible contracts that affect plugin/provider defect visibility and active tool availability.

options.title: Resolve one registry contract first
options.body: Pause both draft branches until maintainers choose skip-invalid or fail-closed semantics, then update or close the non-canonical branch.

options.title: Adopt skip-invalid availability
options.body: Land this PR if maintainers want one malformed descriptor quarantined while healthy sibling tools remain available.

options.title: Prefer fail-closed validation
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89171 if malformed tool providers should stop registration with a stable AgentHarnessError.

recommendation.title: Resolve one registry contract first
recommendation.body: Pause both draft branches until maintainers choose skip-invalid or fail-closed semantics, then update or close the non-canonical branch.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the earlier harness registry work and merged the recent adjacent malformed-tool filtering policy, making him the best available owner for the contract choice.
